tools.name: search_kits
tools.description: Search released miniature, architecture and terrain kits. Words are matched together. Filter for free files or a maximum USD price before tax. Returns current public details and tracked product links.

tools.name: get_kit
tools.description: Get the exact contents, scale, formats, price, original print photo, known limitations and personal-use license for a released kit. Use an id from search_kits.

tools.name: get_purchase_link
tools.description: Return a tracked product-page link for the buyer to review and buy, or download a free kit. Does not create an order, charge money, accept terms or provide paid files. Price is before applicable tax.
